subject: Car accident on the A40 - need a solicitor
body:
Hello,

I was referred to your firm by a friend after a car accident I was involved in last week on the A40 near Denham. The other driver, a Sarah Connelly, pulled out of a junction and hit the side of my car. My vehicle registration is LM19 XYZ, hers was KP68 FRJ.

I have photos of the damage and a police reference number (A40-2201-889) if that helps. I haven't dealt with a solicitor before so I don't have any reference number from you yet - this is the first time I'm contacting you.

Could someone call me on 07700 900123 to discuss?

Thanks,
James Whitfield
